notes: Calendar-year season (6 Feb - 30 Oct 2026). 10 clubs, each plays the other four times (twice home, twice away): 36 matches per club, 180 in total. Single row, so closed both ways; the First Division (level 2) is outside our data. Normal movement: 10th relegated directly, 9th plays a two-legged promotion/relegation tie against the First Division play-off winner, First Division champion promoted directly. In 2026 Sligo Rovers went down directly and Drogheda United lost the play-off to UCD (First Division play-off winner), so 2 clubs left the division. Note the play-off is not inside the Premier Division table, so no playoff object is recorded.
